opportunity.name: Edge-Powered CLI Agent Backend
opportunity.description: Use Cloudflare Workers as a zero-ops backend for CLI agents that call DeepSeek API. The CLI (npm-installed) sends requests to a Worker, which proxies to DeepSeek and returns results. Fully automatable via CLI/API, agent-to-agent (CLI agent to Worker agent), currently possible in 2026.

platforms.cli_tool: Node.js CLI via npm (e.g., oclif or commander)

architecture.step1: CLI tool installed via npm, sends HTTP POST to Worker URL with prompt.
architecture.step2: Worker receives request, validates API key from KV, calls DeepSeek API.
architecture.step3: Worker streams or returns response to CLI.
architecture.step4: CLI displays result. Billing handled via Worker (e.g., Stripe or crypto).

free_tier_limits.cloudflare_workers: 100,000 requests/day free (paid: unlimited at $5/month for 10M requests). Sufficient for small-scale agents.
free_tier_limits.vercel_edge: 1M requests/month free (100ms execution), but 10s timeout limit (too low for DeepSeek). Workers better.

feasibility_analysis.latency: Edge adds ~50-100ms vs direct DeepSeek call. Negligible for LLM responses (1-5s). Workers in 300+ locations reduce global latency for CLI users.
feasibility_analysis.timeout: Cloudflare Workers: 30s default, up to 900s (15 min) with paid plan ($5/month). DeepSeek calls <60s, so 30s default may fail. Use paid plan or upgrade to 60s via `requestTimeoutMs` (not supported). Workaround: use Durable Objects (no timeout) or split calls. Viable with paid Workers.
feasibility_analysis.state_and_keys: Yes, Workers KV stores API keys, user state, and usage counters. 1GB free, $0.50/GB after. Key-value pairs with TTL.
feasibility_analysis.billing: Yes, implement usage-based billing via Stripe API (checkout sessions) or crypto (Solana Pay). Worker handles webhooks and KV for credits.

cost_comparison.cloudflare_workers_paid: $5/month for 10M requests + $0.50/GB KV. Total ~$10/month for 1M requests.
cost_comparison.vps_4_49: $4.49/month (e.g., RackNerd) + $0.50 for domain + maintenance. Requires setup, monitoring, scaling. At 1M requests, VPS may need upgrade ($10-20/month).
cost_comparison.aws_lambda: $0.20 per 1M requests + $0.0000166667/GB-second. For 1M requests at 1s each: ~$16.67/month. More expensive.
cost_comparison.conclusion: Workers cheaper than Lambda and comparable to VPS at low scale. At high scale (10M+ req), Workers $5/month beats VPS ($20+).

opportunity.revenue_model: Usage-based billing: $0.001 per request (1000 requests for $1). With 100K requests/month, revenue $100. Cost: $10 (Workers) + DeepSeek API ($0.14/1M tokens, ~$14 for 1M requests at 100 tokens each) = $24. Profit: $76/month.
opportunity.implementation_complexity: Medium (2-3 days). Steps: (1) Write Worker in JavaScript/TypeScript with DeepSeek API call. (2) Set up KV for keys/state. (3) Build CLI tool with npm. (4) Integrate Stripe for billing. (5) Deploy via wrangler CLI.
opportunity.capital_required: $10 (Cloudflare Workers paid plan) + $0 (DeepSeek free tier for testing) + $0 (Stripe free). Total: $10.

risks.timeout: DeepSeek calls >30s may fail on free plan. Use paid Workers with Durable Objects or split requests.
risks.rate_limits: DeepSeek API rate limits (unknown, but typical 60 req/min). Implement queue in Worker.
risks.billing_complexity: Stripe integration requires webhook handling. Use crypto for simpler on-chain billing.

opportunity.recommendation: Viable and profitable. Use Cloudflare Workers paid plan ($5/month) with Durable Objects for long-running DeepSeek calls. Start with 100K requests/day, scale up. Cheaper than VPS at scale, zero ops.
